name: TOI-561
description: Star of 5,342 K, 85.8 parsecs away, with 4 transiting planets.

radius.source: Piotto et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-561 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

mass.source: Piotto et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-561 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

temperature.source: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of TOI-561 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: 4 planets cross TOI-561 as seen from Earth: b, c, d, e.
text.introduction: Its radius follows Piotto et al. 2024, and its temperature MacDougall et al. 2023.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname MACDOUGALL_ET_AL__2023, PIOTTO_ET_AL__2024): st_teff 5342, st_rad 0.843, st_mass 0.806

quotes.title: TOI-561
quotes.card: TOI-561 is an old, metal-poor, Sun-like star, known to have multiple small exoplanets orbiting it.
quotes.introduction: It is an orange dwarf, estimated to be 10.5 billion years old, and about 79% the mass and 85% the radius of the Sun.
